summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for sharp pain at her G-tube site, which had worsened after running out of oxycodone. She had a history of similar episodes with prior admissions showing inflammatory changes without infection. On admission, she was started on oxycodone with good pain control and remained on continuous tube feeds (NutriHep at 50 cc/hr). She was afebrile and hemodynamically stable throughout. IV Dilaudid was available for breakthrough pain but not required after initial oral dosing. An enteral infusion was completed without issues. She was discharged home with a prescription for oxycodone, instructions to resume home feeds and monitor blood glucose, and advised to follow up with her surgeon.
